import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
for n in ['spectral','trees']:
 p=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(Path.cwd()/'sources'/ (n+'.pdf')),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert p.returncode==0
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/'+n+'.txt'],input=p.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True); assert z.returncode==0
 print('SOURCE',n,p.stdout)
